title: Present perfect have/has + past participle · 典型例句(第2轮)
summary: have/has + past participle expresses an action that happened in the past and its impact on the present.本课为典型例句练习,核心:Present perfect emphasizes the present result and impact of a past action。

title: Present perfect vs past simple · 典型例句(第2轮)
summary: Determine the tense by whether there is a past time adverbial and whether the present result matters.本课为典型例句练习,核心:Present perfect emphasizes impact on the present; past simple states a past event with an explicit past time。

title: for / since time phrases · 典型例句(第2轮)
summary: The time adverbials of the present perfect: for takes a duration, since takes a starting point.本课为典型例句练习,核心:for + length of time; since + point in time。

title: Past continuous · 典型例句(第2轮)
summary: The past continuous depicts what was happening at a certain past time.本课为典型例句练习,核心:was/were + V-ing indicates an action in progress at a past moment。

title: when / while and the past continuous · 典型例句(第2轮)
summary: was/were doing + when + past simple: the continuous is the background, the past simple is the interrupting event.本课为典型例句练习,核心:The longer action in the past continuous is the background; the shorter action in the past simple interrupts it。

title: Past perfect · 典型例句(第2轮)
summary: The past perfect expresses an action completed before a past reference point: by the time / before / after.本课为典型例句练习,核心:had + past participle indicates 'past of the past'。

title: Passive voice in the present · 典型例句(第2轮)
summary: The passive voice in the present: be + past participle, emphasizing the receiver of the action.本课为典型例句练习,核心:am/is/are + past participle; the receiver of the action becomes the subject。

title: Passive voice in the past · 典型例句(第2轮)
summary: The passive voice in the past depicts a past action from the receiver's perspective.本课为典型例句练习,核心:was/were + past participle。

title: Modal passive can be done · 典型例句(第2轮)
summary: Modal verbs in the passive: can/must/should + be + past participle.本课为典型例句练习,核心:Modal verb + be + past participle。

title: Relative clauses who / that (people) · 典型例句(第2轮)
summary: A relative clause modifies a person: who/that replaces the antecedent inside the clause.本课为典型例句练习,核心:who/that introduces a relative clause modifying a person, as subject or object。

title: Relative clauses which / that (things) · 典型例句(第2轮)
summary: A relative clause modifies a thing: which/that; the clause follows right after the antecedent.本课为典型例句练习,核心:which/that introduces a relative clause modifying a thing。

title: Relative clauses where / when · 典型例句(第2轮)
summary: Relational adverbs introduce relative clauses: where = in which, when = on which.本课为典型例句练习,核心:where modifies a place, when modifies a time, acting as an adverbial inside the clause。

title: Object clauses with that · 典型例句(第2轮)
summary: An object clause serves as the object of a verb like say/think/know/believe; the word order must be statement order.本课为典型例句练习,核心:that introduces an object clause; the clause uses statement word order。

title: Object clauses with if / whether and question words · 典型例句(第2轮)
summary: if/whether and special question words introduce object clauses; the key exam point is word order.本课为典型例句练习,核心:Object clauses with question words still use statement word order。

title: Adverbial clauses of time with when / before / after · 典型例句(第2轮)
summary: A time adverbial clause introduced by when/before/after/as soon as; the future is expressed with the present.本课为典型例句练习,核心:The tense in the time clause: main clause future, subordinate clause present。

title: First conditional if...will · 典型例句(第2轮)
summary: First conditional: if + present, main clause will + base verb, expressing a real future possibility.本课为典型例句练习,核心:If clause present, main clause future (will); subordinate clause never uses will。

title: Adverbial clauses of reason with because / since / as · 典型例句(第2轮)
summary: Reason adverbial clauses: because is strongest, since/as introduce reasons both sides already know.本课为典型例句练习,核心:because gives a direct reason; since/as gives a known reason; tone weakens in turn。

title: Adverbial clauses of concession with although / though · 典型例句(第2轮)
summary: although/though introduces a concession: cannot be used together with but.本课为典型例句练习,核心:although + clause: 'although...but' cannot be used together in the same sentence。

title: Adverbials of purpose with to / in order to · 典型例句(第2轮)
summary: Adverbials of purpose express purpose: to/in order to + base verb, so that + clause.本课为典型例句练习,核心:to + base verb = in order to; so that introduces a clause。

title: Infinitives as object want to do · 典型例句(第2轮)
summary: Verbs like want, decide, hope, plan, promise are followed by the infinitive as object.本课为典型例句练习,核心:want/decide/hope/plan + to + base verb。

title: Gerunds as object enjoy doing · 典型例句(第2轮)
summary: Verbs like enjoy, finish, practice, mind, keep are followed by the gerund as object.本课为典型例句练习,核心:enjoy/finish/practice/mind/keep + V-ing。

title: Gerunds after prepositions · 典型例句(第2轮)
summary: A verb after a preposition takes the gerund: at/in/on/of/for/about + V-ing.本课为典型例句练习,核心:Prepositions are followed by V-ing: be good at doing, be interested in doing。

title: so...that / too...to / enough to · 典型例句(第2轮)
summary: Three result structures: so...that, too...to (negative meaning), enough to (affirmative meaning).本课为典型例句练习,核心:so + adjective + that clause; too + adjective + to do; adjective + enough + to do。

title: Tag questions · 典型例句(第2轮)
summary: Tag questions: front affirmative, tag negative, and vice versa; reuse the be/auxiliary/modal of the main clause.本课为典型例句练习,核心:Affirmative in the front, negative in the tag; the tense and pronoun of the tag match the main clause。

title: Exclamatory sentences What / How · 典型例句(第2轮)
summary: Exclamatory sentences start with What or How: What a/an + adjective + singular noun; How + adjective.本课为典型例句练习,核心:What + noun phrase; How + adjective/adorb。

title: both / either / neither · 典型例句(第2轮)
summary: both/either/neither express the quantity relationships of two objects; mind singular and plural agreement.本课为典型例句练习,核心:both = both (affirmative), neither = neither (negative), either = either of two options。

title: used to past habits · 典型例句(第2轮)
summary: used to expresses a past habit or state that no longer exists.本课为典型例句练习,核心:used to + base verb = often did something in the past (not now)。

title: as...as comparisons · 典型例句(第2轮)
